CreateTransitUploadPolicy.description_en: Generates a credential for direct file upload. The caller can use the returned upload policy to upload a file directly to object storage
CreateTransitUploadPolicy.description_zh: 生成文件直传凭证。调用方可以使用返回的上传策略将文件直接上传到对象存储

DeleteSkill.description_en: Soft-deletes a Skill that the current caller has permission to modify
DeleteSkill.description_zh: 软删除当前调用者有权修改的 Skill

GetAgent.description_en: Queries an agent visible to the current identity by name
GetAgent.description_zh: 按名称查询当前身份可见的 Agent

GetSkill.description_en: Queries a Skill by name that is visible to the current caller
GetSkill.description_zh: 按名称查询当前调用者可见的 Skill

GetTransitMeta.description_en: Queries the metadata of a Transit file, including the upload status, file size, and expiration time, and optionally generates a temporary download URL
GetTransitMeta.description_zh: 查询 Transit 文件的上传状态、文件大小、过期时间等元数据，并可按需获取临时下载链接

ListAgents.description_en: Queries agents visible to the current identity by paging
ListAgents.description_zh: 分页查询当前身份可见的 Agent

ListSkills.description_en: Queries Skills visible to the current caller by paging
ListSkills.description_zh: 分页查询当前调用者可见的 Skill

UpdateAgent.description_en: Updates the configuration of an Agent
